requirements: An acknowledged publish must never be repeated during the same run just because install availability is delayed
On resume, query accepted exact-version metadata and reject differing integrity before considering another upload
Verify accepted native version integrity, then allow their availability scans to overlap
Wait for every native package index before publishing the CLI, then wait for the CLI index
Bound read-only waits, fail immediately on integrity mismatch and preserve partial publication on timeout
Record automatic latest tags on prereleases as an owner review decision: registry removal returned 400; never silently promote, delete a version, or add a stored token
